_about: Code-set lookup. Country -> code set -> codes, units, indoor conditions, U-value set and clause references. Clause numbers follow the editions listed; check them against the licensed edition the project is designed to. Edit freely.
_status: Clause references and indoor conditions compiled for preliminary design. VERIFY against the current adopted edition before issue.
